ThingDef.label: Wraith Dart
ThingDef.description: A Wraith culling and interceptor craft. Its Stargate-specific culling beam can dematerialize exact biological captives into the shuttle's native transport buffer, while boarding and launch remain governed by RimWorld's shuttle systems.

li.notHackedInspectString: Wraith flight and culling controls are secured.
li.hackedInspectString: Wraith controls breached; shuttle transferred to colony control.
li.hackedMessage: {HACKER} has breached the Wraith Dart controls, released any buffered captives and transferred the surviving shuttle to colony control.

ThingDef.label: Wraith scout craft
ThingDef.description: A Wraith scout, shuttle and cargo craft larger than a Dart. It represents the canon Wraith scout-vessel role rather than a redundant second fighter: reconnaissance, personnel movement and light transport while preserving native shuttle boarding and launch.

ThingDef.label: Wraith cruiser transport
ThingDef.description: A RimWorld-scale abstraction of the smaller Wraith cruiser/transport role: a heavier organic assault and personnel craft used to move ground teams and support Wraith operations. Native shuttle boarding remains authoritative; full strategic cruisers and hive ships remain larger-scale vessels.

ThingDef.label: Puddle Jumper
ThingDef.description: An Ancient/Lantean gate-capable shuttle. Native RimWorld/Odyssey shuttle systems own boarding, loading and launch; WNG adds Ancient control and drone-weapon behavior around that native foundation.

ThingDef.label: Al'kesh transport
ThingDef.description: A Goa'uld Al'kesh-derived bomber and troop transport. WNG exposes it only through optional ONAC/RimGate-Jaffa integration; native RimWorld/Odyssey shuttle systems retain boarding, loading and launch behavior.
